 Judgment

This appeal has been filed under Section 173 of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 (the Act) by the claim petitioner in O.P.(MV) No.1248/2017 on the file of the Motor Accident Claims Tribunal,
Irinjalakkuda, (the Tribunal), aggrieved by the amount of compensation granted by Award dated 12/02/2020.
The sole respondent herein is the second respondent/insurer in the petition.
In this appeal, the parties and documents will be referred to as described in the original petition.

2. According to the claim petitioner, on 15/05/2017 at about 04:00 p.m., while he was riding motorcycle bearing registration no.KL-04/AE-3323 through Irinjalakuda- 2025:KER:74190 Kallettumkara public road and when he reached near the place by name Vallakkunnu, car bearing registration no.KL-45/P-796 driven by the first respondent in a rash and negligent manner knocked him down, as a result of which he sustained grievous injuries.
A sum of 5,00,000/- was claimed as compensation under various heads.
3. The first respondent-owner cum driver of the offending car filed written statement denying negligence on his part.
4. Before the Tribunal, no oral evidence was adduced by either side.
Exts.A1 to A15 were marked on the side of the claim petitioner.
No documentary evidence was produced by the second respondent/insurer.

5. The Tribunal on consideration of the documentary evidence and after hearing both sides, found negligence on the part of the first respondent-driver of the offending vehicle resulting in the incident and hence awarded an amount of 3,15,000/- together with interest @ 8% per annum from the date 2025:KER:74190 of the petition till realisation along with proportionate costs.
Aggrieved by the Award, the claim petitioner has come up in appeal.
6. The only point that arises for consideration in this appeal is whether there is any infirmity in the findings of the Tribunal calling for an interference by this Court.

7. Heard both sides.
8.
The Award of compensation by the Tribunal under the following heads is challenged by the claim petitioner - Notional income

It is submitted by the learned counsel for the claim petitioner that the Jerin Paul vs Reliance General Insurance Company Ltd on 7 October, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/67391831/
2 latter, a driver, licensed to drive heavy vehicles also, was earning 20,000/- per month.

the Tribunal fixed the notional income at 10,000/-, which is quite low going by the dictum in Manusha Sreekumar v. The United India Insurance Co.Ltd., (2022) 17 SCC 321.

sentences.text: Ext.A15 driving license substantiates the claim regarding the avocation of the claim petitioner.
The person who issued Ext.A13 salary certificate was not examined and therefore the Tribunal was not inclined to admit the same in evidence.
I do not find any infirmity in the said finding.
However, going by the dictum in Manusha Sreekumar (Supra), the income of the claim petitioner can be fixed as 15,600/-.
Loss of earnings 9.

The materials on record show that the claim petitioner sustained the following injuries- " 1. Traumatic spine injury.
2. T5 compression fracture.
3. Left mandible fracture.

4. Fracture right transverse process T4, T5 and T6."
He was hospitalized for a period of 10 days.
In all probability, he might have been unable to work for a period of 6 months.
Hence, 2025:KER:74190 he can be awarded a compensation at the rate of 15,600/- for a period of six months, that is, 15,600/- x 6 = 93,600/-.
Pain and suffering 10.
In the light of the injuries sustained, an amount of 1,00,000/- as claimed appears to be just and reasonable.
Loss of amenities 11.
In the facts in circumstances of the case, an amount of 60,000/- under this head would just and reasonable.

granted by the Tribunal + 2,23,514/- granted in appeal) with interest at the rate 2025:KER:74190 of 8% per annum from the date of petition till date of realization and proportionate costs.
The second respondent/ insurer is directed to deposit the aforesaid amount before the Tribunal within a period of 60 days from the date of receipt of a copy of the judgment.
